correctness.rationale: For fixed α>1 and specified Pozsgay permutation gate and normalized one-site transition or domain-wall state (infinite-volume limit first), group the count-resolved coefficient matrix by difference d=ℓ-k. At fixed d, branch matrices occupy mutually orthogonal count rows/columns, so ||M_d||_(2α)^(2α)=2^((1-α)g(d)) Σ_k(q_k r_(k+d))^α. Uniform binomial peak and overlap bounds make the sum at most Oα(t^(1/2-α)); g(d)>=|d|-1 gives a convergent geometric factor across d. Schatten triangle yields the global upper bound. Count-diagonal phase pinching is contractive and, using g(0)=0 and the local central binomial lower bound for Θ(sqrt(t)) central k, yields a matching Ωα(t^(1/2-α)). Therefore Zα=Θα(t^(1/2-α)) and Sα=((α-1/2)/(α-1))log t+Oα(1). I checked that this does not assume cross-difference orthogonality. Independent binomial overlap computations corroborated asymptotic scaling; finite checks are not the infinity-time proof.
